Tsunami Information Bulletin from the PTWC

contents.bytes: At least 10 people killed in Cotabato, 10 in South Cotabato and 3 in Davao del Sur. At least 361 people injured in Cotabato, 81 in South Cotabato, 79 in Davao del Sur, 25 at Davao, 8 in Lanao del Norte, 6 in Bukidnon, 1 in Maguindanao and 1 in Sultan Kudarat. Three people missing due to landslides in Davao del Sur. At least 40,447 buildings and 30 roads and bridges damaged; landslides and liquefaction occurred; widespread power and water outages throughout south-central and southern Mindanao. Information is for this event and the M 6.5 event on October 31 at 01:11 UTC.
